children: Keppel DC REIT stands to benefit from rental escalation at two new data centers in Japan which it plans to acquire, UOB Kay Hian's Jonathan Koh says in a research report. The data centers offer attractive built-in contractual rental escalation of 2.8%, the analyst notes. Also, the REIT continues to build scale in hyperscale data centers, with potential acquisitions from its sponsor's pipeline likely to materialize in 2028. The brokerage lifts its 2027 and 2028 distribution-per-unit forecasts for the REIT by 1.3% and 1.7%, respectively. It raises the unit's target price to 2.99 Singapore dollars from S$2.95 with an unchanged buy rating. Units are 1.4% higher at S$2.22. (ronnie.harui@wsj.com)
